text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help refresh your E-Commerce website quickly and cleanly.

With 7 years of experience across full stack web development, I work confidently with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While my background is broader than WordPress alone, I’m comfortable jumping into existing websites, making practical updates fast, and keeping the work focused on what matters most: a polished, responsive result.

For example, in one project I built embedded customer analytics dashboards for a B2B SaaS product so each customer account could see its own metrics. That work rolled out to 140 customer accounts and was delivered 3 weeks early. In another project, I built a multilingual documentation site in 4 languages with instant search, which helped reduce support tickets by 27%. Both projects required careful UI work, strong attention to detail, and delivering something reliable under real-world constraints.

For your WordPress E-Commerce refresh, I can help with:
- connecting the new domain
- re-uploading product images
- making minor layout tweaks for a fresher look
- checking the site for responsive behavior across screen sizes

I understand this is an immediate need, and I’m comfortable moving quickly while keeping the site stable and presentable. My approach is straightforward: review the current setup, make the requested changes efficiently, and keep the user experience clean and responsive.

If you’d like, I can get started right away and help you update the site with minimal back-and-forth.
